competency_fulfillment.rationale: Seed 42's '5 equal parts. 2 parts are shaded' (2/5) and seed 43's 3/4 correctly exercise non-unit similar fractions, but the competency also names 'groups of objects, fraction charts, fraction tiles, and the number line' as required media, and only the divided-shape/chart form ever appears across all eight samples.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Three of the four named representation types — groups of objects, fraction tiles, and the number line — never appear in any sample, and denominators 2 and 6 (both listed alongside 3, 4, 5, 8) are absent too; only 3 (seed 50), 4 (seed 43), 5 (seed 42) and 8 (seeds 44/45) surface.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Prompts like seed 44's 'A shape is divided into 8 equal parts. 3 parts are shaded.' stay to one plain sentence, matching grade 2 quarter 4 demand.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Formats vary (mcq, read_mcq, set_click, cloze), but every single one renders the same divided-shape visual, e.g. seed 72 repeats seed 42's '5 equal parts. 2 parts are shaded' wording verbatim, leaving no fraction-tile or number-line variant.

competency_alignment.rationale: The non-unit fractions produced (2/5 in seed 42, 3/8 in seed 44) correctly build the 'similar fractions share a denominator family' concept this competency targets, without drifting to an unrelated skill.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Denominators used (3, 4, 5, 8) and numerators always less than the denominator (e.g. seed 44's 3/8) stay inside the competency's named ceiling of 8.
